messages:
nina: Opened a small docs PR clarifying how tiered metering rounds after batch aggregation and added an SDK header example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5410

tara: Can you paste the repro and the code snippet you want? I'll do copy edits and update console links.

nina: Repro in PR: multiple near-simultaneous single-vector embedding calls grouped into micro-batches -> meter sums per-batch -> rounding applied -> billed units differ from naive per-call rounding. Added a 2-row table and a remediation note.

kevin: Suggested remediation: request per-call semantics via header `x-redwood-billing-intent: per-call` or use the bulk API. Added compact Node + curl examples to the PR.

tara: Update console pointer too: old docs said "Metering > Tiered Usage" but Console now shows "Billing > Cost & Usage > Tiered metering (panel: Tiering by unit type)". Also change heading to "When to request per-call semantics" and tighten wording.

nina: Done. Pushed tests and a short changelog blurb. docs-bot: PR opened by nina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5410 labels: docs, metering, sdk-snippet.

kevin: Filing runtime follow-up RUNTIME-811 to surface the billing-intent header in metering logs for audit.

tara: I'll review and merge if all good.

nina: Thanks all, leaving thread open for last checks."
